mesh_sweep.rationale: Synthetic 1D-bar ENERGY-LEAK variant; mesh axis held constant but the audit's energy_partition deviation propagates as an unstable verdict — the per-frame energy balance is non-physical, so the convergence_combined_verdict cannot be stable.

dt_sweep.rationale: frame_dt unchanged from canonical (1e-5 s); the dt axis instability reflects the synthetic energy injection at frame 30, not a CFL violation. A reviewer reading this case must check the audit first.
